C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY.Summary: RM-GOVERNED-PATH Phase P0 (steps 1, 2, 3, 5): reject, do not filter — convert every silent discard of authored input under src/artifact/ and src/project-utils.ts so unrecognized tokens raise, and lint no longer stays green while intent is dropped.
C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY.Problem:
The parser discards authored input the grammar does not recognize, and lint stays green while it happens. This is a class defect (RC-1), not three isolated incidents.
Documented instances include LINKS: M-A M-B linking nothing, comma multi-value DependsOn rejected as one bad token, and text inside GD-*/VD-* Owns surfacing only as projection.graph.unlisted-anchor. The P0 derivation inventory (docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/p0-derivation.md) found ten silent .filter() discards in scope — seven unknown before the sweep — spanning MODULE_CONTRACT lists, index Owns and document routes, ledger Allocation/Event parse nulls, empty EscalatedTask, and non-task children under ImplementationPlan.
Site 11 was found in review after the sweep classified grammar.ts:2012 as justified empty cleanup: readTaskDependencies keeps child text only and never the child tag, so <DependsOn><T-001 /></DependsOn> parses to zero dependencies while <Task> text and bare text forms work. Neighbouring constructs (Satisfies, DurableScope) teach the anchor-tag form; an applied archived bundle in this repository carries that form as a no-op. The inventory count is now eleven.
The product thesis is that the agent cannot lie to the model; these paths invert it — the model silently drops what the agent authored. Turning each silent failure loud is not a compatibility break (D5.2/D5.3): no NGRACE_ARTIFACT_VERSION bump. Newly-erroring codes are named in the conventional-commit body (D5.5), not by hand-editing CHANGELOG.md.

Goals.Goal: Complete the P0.1 inventory as a class fix: every silent-discard site in src/artifact/ and src/project-utils.ts either raises or is reclassified on evidence as already paired (raising code named). No leave-silent justification.

LINKS and DEPENDS split on [,;\s]+ (D5.1; colon excluded); preserve [..] stripping and none handling (F3); emit markup.unparsed-link-token naming token, accepted separators, and accepted families for the field.

DependsOn text nodes split on the same separator set before per-token T-NNN validation; Task children and anchor-tag children (T-NNN) remain valid and equivalent (D7); change.task-invalid-dependency names accepted shapes and fires only when neither tag nor text resolves.
Malformed Allocation and Event under run-ledger.xml raise ledger-integrity errors (corrupt audit trail), never silent null drops and never markup.* codes.
Empty EscalatedTask and non-task ImplementationPlan children raise; every conversion has a regression test that fails on pre-fix code.

Constraints.Constraint: Binding decisions: D5.1 separator set; D5.2/D5.3 silent-failure-made-loud (no NGRACE_ARTIFACT_VERSION bump); D5.4/D5.5 newly-erroring codes in conventional-commit body; F3 preserve bracket and none handling.

Scope is exactly P0 steps 1, 2, 3, 5 and the eleven inventory silent discards. Do not touch src/grace-cursor.ts, src/calibration/, or gate/lint-summary surfaces belonging to C-CURSOR-INTEGRITY and C-REPORT-HONESTY.

D7 — DependsOn anchor children: readTaskDependencies resolves a child tag when it matches ANCHOR_PATTERNS.task, child text when non-empty, and raises change.task-invalid-dependency only when neither resolves. Do not raise solely because the author used the anchor form; archived bundles use <T-NNN /> children and must acquire the dependency they claimed (repair under D5.3). Do not edit archive history.
Ledger parse-null conversions stay in grammar.ts as ledger.* integrity codes; they do not migrate to the cursor bundle.
Do not hand-edit CHANGELOG.md (D5.5). Do not set status to approved in this authoring pass; approval is a human act.
Evidence doctrine: TraceAssertion + tests default; Marker only for runtime trajectory. Write each regression test first, watch it fail on pre-fix code, then fix.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Cursor recovery, auto-open, listLooseEvents NaN skip, numeric --from/--to validation (P0.4, P0.6 — C-CURSOR-INTEGRITY).
Calibration backfill / P0.8 and any edit under src/calibration/ or grace-cursor adjudication (bound by D6 / corr 156).
Verdict diagnostics gate.apply.no-verdict rewrite (P0.7) and mode-aware lint summary (P0.9 — C-REPORT-HONESTY).
NGRACE_ARTIFACT_VERSION bump or migration of legitimate working states into errors.
Hand-written CHANGELOG.md edits; sibling bundle files for C-CURSOR-INTEGRITY and C-REPORT-HONESTY.
Accepting colon as a LINKS/DEPENDS separator (explicitly excluded by D5.1).

No silent discard remains in the inventory scope without a written reclassification.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LINKS-DEPENDS-INTEGRITY: LINKS: M-A M-B and LINKS: M-A; M-B parse to two module links; any token matching no accepted family for the field raises markup.unparsed-link-token naming token, separators [,;\s]+, and accepted families; none and [..] handling still work (F3).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DEPENDSON-MULTI: DependsOn text T-001, T-002 (and semicolon/whitespace forms) yields two dependencies when both are valid T-NNN ids; change.task-invalid-dependency names accepted shapes (multi-value text list and Task children) and fires only when a candidate resolves neither as a task tag nor as non-empty task text. Task children remain valid.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-OWNS-DIAGNOSIS: Text inside Owns where self-closing anchors belong raises a direct Owns diagnosis, not only projection.graph.unlisted-anchor; invalid Owns children raise rather than filter.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-INDEX-AND-PLAN-DISCARD: Non-GD children under GraphDocuments, non-VD under VerificationDocuments, empty EscalatedTask, and non-task ImplementationPlan children each raise a dedicated error.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LEDGER-INTEGRITY: Unparseable Allocation and Event under run-ledger.xml raise ledger-integrity codes (ledger.invalid-allocation / ledger.invalid-event class), not markup codes and not silent null drops with only secondary event-outside-allocation symptoms.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-REGRESSION-AND-SUITE: Every conversion has a regression test that fails on pre-fix code; corpus replays include F-1 comma DependsOn, LINKS: M-A M-B, and Owns text; bun run validate:ci and bun run ngrace lint --path . are green on this repository.
